meta.title: Workspace Tree
meta.description: Adds nested folders to the sidebar session list. Each workspace row has a ... menu with Add folder and Rename workspace, and its + button starts a new session there. Drag a session or a folder onto another row to regroup it, including into a different workspace; a session's ... menu offers Rename, Copy session ID, Fork session, Archive session, Delete session and Move. Deleted sessions go to a recoverable trash that the plugin settings page lists and clears. Turning the plugin off restores the flat session list and keeps the folders for later.
